elements.element: Upon expiry or termination of the agreement, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Article XXI-A applies upon “expiration or termination ... for any reason” and requires Licensor to provide transition assistance at Licensee’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Article XXI-A(a) expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Article XXI-A(b) requires Licensor to return to Licensee all defined “Licensee Data.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The introductory termination trigger applies to subsection (b), which requires return “within thirty (30) days.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Article XXI-A(b) expressly requires a “standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Article XXI-A(c) requires Licensor, “after such return,” to delete all Licensee Data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Article XXI-A(c) requires Licensor to certify the deletion in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination of the agreement, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Article XXI-A applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires transition assistance at Licensee’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The right to request transition assistance for up to six months encompasses a 90-day assistance period.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Article XXI-A(b) requires return of all Licensee Data to Licensee in a standard machine-readable format, satisfying the export requirement.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Article XXI-A(b), governed by the opening expiration-or-termination trigger, requires return within thirty days.

result.reason: The added operative clause fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. The request condition is an ordinary mechanism allowing Licensee to invoke the assistance and does not materially diminish the entitlement. The changes are confined to transition assistance, data return, and deletion certification, without altering unrelated commercial terms or creating a contradiction.
